TASK: Inspect the original Orca codebase under ui/original-dist and reference image at /var/folders/zh/7cc25lt91b1_dj577306nwdh0000gn/T/clipboard-2026-08-21-141049-56982340.png.
DELIVERABLE: Write a comprehensive report at .omo/evidence/rorca/orca-architecture-findings.md detailing:

STOP WHEN: .omo/evidence/rorca/orca-architecture-findings.md is written with complete architectural specifications.
